bear_assumptions: About USD 500 million of forward revenue at 5x enterprise value/revenue, USD 100 million of net financial resources and 67 million diluted shares as growth slows, adjusted breakeven slips, cash burn and dilution persist, and the premium multiple compresses.
base_assumptions: About USD 550 million of forward revenue at 8x enterprise value/revenue, USD 130 million of net financial resources and 65 million diluted shares as low-20s growth moderates, gross margin remains above 50%, and profitability improves gradually with continuing stock compensation.
bull_assumptions: About USD 600 million of forward revenue at 11x enterprise value/revenue, USD 150 million of net financial resources and 64 million diluted shares as DSPS and NGS sustain strong growth, Q4 breakeven becomes durable positive cash economics, and dilution slows.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if fresh primary evidence and revised scenarios clear expected-return, base-upside, bear/base and expected/bear payoff, margin-of-safety, confidence and accepted-relationship gates; downgrade if Q4 adjusted-EBITDA breakeven slips without a credible temporary cause, revenue growth or gross margin materially undershoots guidance, operating cash use accelerates as growth moderates, dilution offsets operating progress, customer adoption stalls, or the platform loses cost, quality, or turnaround-time competitiveness.
